title: Session — Unicorn gate, awakened forest & river ambush
resumePoint: Combat is active at the riverbank. Enemies A and B are dead; C appears to remain alive. Three unidentified creatures have approached from behind, with sounds of more following. Gor appears to be next in initiative—confirm with Joe. Korhal escaped his grapple. At least one summoned octopus went down; check the other. Rirruto granted 16 temporary HP during this fight; check remaining amounts. The aboleth disappeared and was not confirmed killed. The party had not boarded the rafts when the encounter began. [02:35–02:52]
recap:
Jack was missing after entering the unicorn portal. The party reopened it using the toy unicorn’s horn and scouted with Zorthalan’s familiar. Gor, a Goliath fighter, emerged carrying an unconscious Jack and joined the group in pursuit of glory. [00:05–00:27]

Healing and Dispel Magic did not wake Jack. Korhal detected a faint magical aura with no clear school. The party completed a long rest in Rirruto’s Tiny Hut, then consulted the alchemist. He associated the condition with an Elder Rune encountered through a portal and suggested waiting. [00:20–00:39]

Darabeth had left the alchemist and was found safe with Jibber Jabber. With Bruce carrying Jack, the party continued through area 12B into the mushroom forest in area 13. They avoided a carrion crawler feeding on a duergar and searched an abandoned dwelling of hardened bat guano, finding two Greater Healing potions. Four awakened trees ambushed the party; all were defeated. [00:40–01:45]

Jack woke naturally after approximately twelve hours and became unusually argumentative. Korhal announced another Detect Magic ritual, but no result is captured. In area 14, two creatures disguised as stalactites engulfed Gor’s and Korhal’s heads. Jack killed Korhal’s attacker; Gor enlarged and removed his own, which Korhal finished. Two rafts and six poles were found. [01:48–02:05]

Heading west to the river, the party encountered an aboleth, which telepathically demanded they leave. Korhal attacked despite Rirruto’s objections, and it disappeared rather than being confirmed dead. Three clawed aquatic creatures attacked. Zorthalan summoned two giant octopuses. Jack killed B and A with critical sling attacks of 63 and 64 damage. More enemies approached from behind, and play paused mid-combat. [02:08–02:52]
discoveries:
- The unicorn-horn gate can be reopened and stays open for about one minute. The destination arch has six empty niches and a mountain-and-sun design. [00:09–00:15]
- Portal/Elder Rune effects may include a prolonged sleep; Jack woke after roughly twelve hours. Do not assume all portal effects behave the same way.
- Four awakened trees were defeated in area 13; more previously felled awakened trees were observed. The carrion crawler was left alone.
- The aboleth communicates telepathically. Its disappearance did not establish that it was defeated.
